summary: Frontend-only final verification of the farm-identity-sync fix (Feed Program). TEST 1 PASS: fresh browser on /?farm=default&t=... renders 'Double B Farm — Broiler Base Mate' (hydrated from GET /api/farm-config, no 'My Farm'). TEST 2 PASS: Settings > Farm Name = 'TEST SYNC ZZ' + Save & Close fired exactly one PATCH /api/farm-config?farm=default&t=... -> 200, and GET confirmed farmName='TEST SYNC ZZ' server-side; DB then restored to exactly 'Double B Farm' (verified by GET, totalSheds untouched at 30). TEST 3 PASS: fresh browser on /?farm=north-creek&t=... renders 'North Creek Farm — Broiler Base Mate'. TEST 4 PASS: End of Batch Bird Summary rows correctly scope per farm — north-creek = 20 rows, default = 30 rows, and every /api/farm-config call carried the correct ?farm=<slug> (verified in the network log for both farms). Regression smoke PASS: Archive tab renders 'Locked Batches Archive' with the closed batch + View Report/Resend Email, settings-upgrade-pay-now present & visible, anonymous QR token access loads the real app, farm-switch cache guard still wipes silo-farm-config, and the only console/API error in the whole session is the pre-existing 401 on /api/auth/me (expected for an anonymous token session). HOWEVER: one HIGH bug found — the server hydration of farmName is nested inside the wizard-check effect which early-returns when localStorage 'feedmate-wizard-done' === '1', so on any browser that has already dismissed/completed the wizard the farm name is NOT hydrated. Deterministic repro included below (farm switch in the same browser -> header falls back to 'My Farm' for BOTH farms).

ui_bugs.issue: farmName hydration is inside the effect that starts with `if (localStorage.getItem(WIZARD_DONE_KEY) === '1') return;`. Any returning user (wizard already dismissed) whose silo-farm-config cache is empty — which the farm-switch cache guard causes on EVERY farm switch, because the guard wipes FARM_CONFIG_KEY but NOT 'feedmate-wizard-done' — never gets the server farm name. Repro (100% reproducible): fresh browser -> /?farm=default&t=... header 'Double B Farm' OK -> navigate to /?farm=north-creek&t=... header shows 'My Farm' (server says 'North Creek Farm') -> navigate back to /?farm=default&t=... header ALSO now shows 'My Farm'. The GET /api/farm-config?farm=north-creek returns 200 with the right name; it is simply never applied. Also makes TEST1/TEST3 timing-sensitive (one run intermittently showed 'My Farm' on north-creek).

Fallback localStorage key 'bbm-active-farm' is never written anywhere in the codebase (index.html writes 'bbm-farm-slug'). So when the URL has no ?farm= param, getActiveFarmSlug() returns 'default' and — because the explicit ?farm= param is now baked into the URL — index.html's fetch monkey-patch can no longer correct it (it only sets farm when absent). Risk: a load without ?farm= while the stored farm is north-creek will GET, and worse PATCH farmName to, farm 'default'. Fix: use 'bbm-farm-slug' (or window.__BBM_FARM__).

Still no data-testid on Farm Name input / Total Sheds input / 'Save & Close' / 'Cancel' (had to select by placeholder and text). Settings trigger is a button named '⚙ Settings' so get_by_text('Settings', exact=True) does not match.
No data-testid on the Bird Summary table/rows — row count had to be derived by DOM traversal.

integration_issues.flow: Farm identity sync after a farm switch
integration_issues.issue: Cache guard wipes the local farm-config but the wizard-done flag survives, and hydration is gated on that flag -> farm name silently degrades to 'My Farm' for every farm on that browser from then on. Fix: move the `if (d?.farmName?.trim()) setFarmConfig(...)` hydration into its own useEffect with no WIZARD_DONE_KEY early-return (and/or add 'feedmate-wizard-done' to the cache-guard wipe list).

action_items: HIGH: extract the farmName hydration out of the wizard-done-gated effect (App.tsx ~9341) into its own unconditional useEffect, so returning users / post-farm-switch loads still hydrate the real farm name from GET /api/farm-config?farm=<slug>.

HIGH: fix getActiveFarmSlug() fallback key: 'bbm-active-farm' -> 'bbm-farm-slug' (or window.__BBM_FARM__). Same dead key is copy-pasted at App.tsx 8603, 11197, 11558, 11567, 11802, 11840, 12218 and EndOfBatchContent.tsx:80 — now that ?farm= is passed explicitly the fetch monkey-patch can no longer silently correct it, so a no-?farm= load can read/PATCH the wrong farm.
LOW: add data-testid to Settings farm-name/total-sheds inputs, Save & Close / Cancel, and the EOB Bird Summary table.
critical_code_review_comments: Two independent sources of the active-farm slug now exist (index.html __BBM_FARM__ from 'bbm-farm-slug', and App.tsx getActiveFarmSlug() from 'bbm-active-farm'). Consolidate to one exported helper reading window.__BBM_FARM__ to prevent cross-farm reads/writes.
Mixing the wizard-dismissal decision and the farm-identity hydration in one effect couples two unrelated concerns and is the direct cause of the remaining bug.
PATCH on save is best-effort with a silent .catch() — a grower renaming their farm offline gets no feedback that the server copy did not update; consider a small toast on failure.

success_rate.frontend: 4/4 requested TESTs pass in the fresh-browser scenario + 5/5 regression checks pass; 1 HIGH residual bug found in the same feature (hydration skipped when wizard-done=1 / after farm switch)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set farm 'default' farmName to 'TEST SYNC ZZ' via the Settings UI (to prove the PATCH fires), then restored via PATCH to exactly 'Double B Farm'. Verified final state: default = 'Double B Farm'/totalSheds 30, north-creek = 'North Creek Farm'/totalSheds 20. No other data created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Served bundle is dist/public/assets/index-DAFPZjzE.js and contains all 4 farm-config?farm= call sites (grep confirms). index.html monkey-patches window.fetch to append ?farm=<bbm-farm-slug> when absent and &t=<bbm-farm-token> for non-/api/auth/ URLs — that's why the explicit ?farm= calls also carry the token. GET/PATCH /api/farm-config require auth (401 without ?t= or a session cookie), so curl must include &t=<token>. Settings trigger = get_by_role('button', name='Settings'); save button text = 'Save & Close'; dismiss 'Skip tour' first or clicks get intercepted. To reproduce the residual bug: load farm A fresh, then navigate to farm B's QR URL in the same browser — header shows 'My Farm'.
rca_of_the_issue: This turn's fix works only on a truly virgin browser. The server->client hydration (`if (d?.farmName?.trim()) setFarmConfig(prev => prev.farmName ? prev : {...prev, farmName: d.farmName})`) was placed inside the pre-existing wizard-check useEffect whose first statement is `if (localStorage.getItem('feedmate-wizard-done') === '1') return;`. On any second visit that flag is '1', so the effect (and therefore the hydration) never runs. Combined with bbmFarmScopedCacheGuard, which deletes FARM_CONFIG_KEY on every farm-slug change but leaves 'feedmate-wizard-done' in place, the app ends up with an empty local farm config AND a short-circuited hydration path — producing the generic 'My Farm' header for every farm after the first switch (verified: default->north-creek->default all show 'My Farm').
